subject: An experimental flu adjuvant sped early antibody quality in over-60s
script: From Agewell Brief: An experimental flu adjuvant sped early antibody quality in over-60s. A study finds an experimental adjuvant may help rebalance immune responses in people over 60, improving early antibody quality without changing overall levels. As we age, our immune system changes in ways that can weaken vaccine responses—a process called immunosenescence. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
